payload.title: File:Camarillasaurus Skeletal.png
payload.description_html:
Skeletal reconstruction of Camarillasaurus cirugedae, a spinosaurine from the Early Cretaceous Camarilla Formation of Spain. Based on the holotype MPG-KPC1-46 (in white), and referred material of the same specimen MPZ 2022/182 (in blue). Unknown material filled in using Spinosaurus, Irritator, Ichthyovenator, and Baryonyx. Total length is approximately 8.8 m through the centra. A partial sacrum and various other fragments are known but either unfigured or difficult to scale, so they aren't included here.

Note: femur, tibia, and surangular/articular have been mirrored from the right side.

References: Sánchez-Hernández and Benton, 2014 and Rauhut et al., 2025.
